title: Current 47-case acceptance matrix after native point/march transition closure

scope.claim: Current 47-case acceptance ledger after LWB-R7-142. Only B11 is promoted: current deterministic native-parser/index transition coverage closes point/march add-update-remove-movement semantics, and a current same-session live Truck proof directly observes exact UUID add/remove/movement.

defectsFoundAndRepaired.defect: R7-131/R7-132 browser fixtures used OS-assigned ephemeral loopback ports; Chromium can reject an assigned port such as 10080 with ERR_UNSAFE_PORT.
defectsFoundAndRepaired.initialFailure: Fresh R7-134 acceptance run failed check_map_data_r7131.cjs at http://127.0.0.1:10080 with net::ERR_UNSAFE_PORT before application assertions ran.
defectsFoundAndRepaired.cause: http.Server.listen(0) delegated port choice to the OS without accounting for Chromium's restricted-port list.
defectsFoundAndRepaired.repair: R7-131 and R7-132 fixtures now use dedicated safe loopback defaults 18081/18082 with LWBRIDGE_R7131_PORT/LWBRIDGE_R7132_PORT overrides.
defectsFoundAndRepaired.final: Both regressions pass, followed by 36 full browser checks and the visual comparator.

R7-092 closes managed/unmanaged ownership offline with selected-root and foreign temporary LastWar processes; only the exact owned selected-root process is stopped and unrelated processes survive.

R7-094 closes the admitted fault matrix offline across path/permission/PE/ABI/readiness/timeouts, bounded cleanup and successful retry without fabricated connected state.
R7-089 live-proves 20 consecutive current-v19 lifecycle cycles: 20 unique sessions/PIDs reached running/connected and every exact owned Stop restored the package with final hashes matching baseline.

R7-090 closes the startup failure matrix offline across six host branches and twelve production-helper transaction stages with journals/hashes/cleanup and a successful retry after every injected failure.

Missing/duplicate/unknown/empty type normalization is covered by current deterministic Map contract checks.

R7-138 retries Start during an active resource scan with a different city selection and caller mode field. Exact SCAN_RUNNING ownership rejection occurs without reacquiring context or changing scanRunId, selectedTypes, backend-selected scanMode/scanStrategy, or concurrency.

R7-138 deterministically proves Stop at early/mid/near-completion boundaries on a five-block run: 0/2/4 completed checkpoints respectively, one in-flight capture canceled, exact partial counters retained, no post-Stop scheduling/checkpoint growth, and prior published data preserved. R7-130 remains the live public Stop-to-idle authority.

R7-139 deliberately stops the exact owned game/bridge while a real Fast Monster scan is active. After a production engine fix, the run terminates as phase=error with exact game connection unavailable, failedBlocks=0, durable status=failed, no partial publication, resumeAvailable=false and exact cleanup/package restoration. Generic capture errors still retain bounded retry behavior.

R7-136 closes the required explicit-safe-rejection branch: an exclusive per-profile scan lease prevents concurrent takeover; orphaned durable running rows become failed with the app-restart reason; checkpoints remain; interrupted staging cannot publish; prior published data survives; fresh scans retain resumeAvailable=false.
Current host/transport and deterministic checks reject stale/foreign session, profile, request and duplicate identities.
Deterministic scan contract covers failed/unread/drop/publication failure semantics and prevents false complete.

R7-142 deterministic end-to-end full-world Dispatch+Truck scans prove stable pointId/marchUuid identity, point update/add/remove, march add/remove, cross-map march movement without duplicate identity, transactional replacement and query-set changes. Current live server-2212 Truck scans A/B published 244/255 rows, shared 58 exact UUIDs, observed all 58 move, plus 197 added and 186 removed; exact 64-bit march UUID remained the indexed record key.
Many repeated completed full-world scans across categories/strategies/servers are durably live-proven.
All result tabs have schemas and legitimate-empty handling, but positive Ghost and Supplies populations remain unavailable/deferred.
Source-backed names/numeric fields are proven across populated kinds; Ghost/Supplies positive representative samples remain unavailable.
Major per-kind filter families are live-proven; remaining positive-population-dependent Ghost/Supplies/Treasure branches prevent a blanket all-kind closure.
Typed sorting/paging/large-ID behavior is deterministic-covered and live sort acceptance exists for Railway/other populated kinds.
Current browser/transport ownership rejects stale request/session responses and keeps current display context authoritative.
